title: Buku Bon Warung Bu Tini
genre: Indonesian balada folk with harmonica (Iwan Fals-style)
subject: the owner of a warung kopi near a Jakarta campus who keeps a dog-eared bon book of students' unpaid kopi and Indomie, reading out their debts every month, then tearing out one page as a gift when a debtor brings his graduation photo
caption: Indonesian balada folk in the style of late-70s Iwan Fals street ballads. Steel-string acoustic guitar with strummed open chords and bass-note walks, harmonica in G playing short wailing answer phrases between lines, plucked upright-style bass, soft brushed snare. Dry close-miked recording, live-in-a-room feel, no polish. Raspy male mid-low vocal, conversational and wry, clearly sung melody. 96 BPM, G major. Mood of a warm teasing ballad told over a glass of kopi tubruk. No pop drums, no synths, no autotune, no rap, no string orchestra.
lyrics:
[Intro - acoustic guitar strum, harmonica phrase]
[Verse 1]
Di warung Bu Tini dekat kampus
Ada buku tulis sampulnya lecek
Isinya nama anak-anak kos
Kopi tubruk, mi rebus, telur setengah matang
[Pre-Chorus]
Tiap tanggal tua dia buka halaman
Dibaca keras, satu-satu disebut
[Chorus]
Doni, tiga belas gelas kopi
Rahmat, mi goreng sebulan penuh
Bayar kapan, Nak? Kapan-kapan, Bu
Buku bon itu makin tebal saja
[Verse 2]
Doni kuliah tujuh tahun
Utangnya sudah dua halaman
Suatu pagi dia datang bertoga
Bawa foto wisuda, bingkainya masih baru
[Bridge - harmonica solo, then quiet guitar]
Bu Tini diam, kacamata turun
Halaman Doni dirobek pelan-pelan
[Chorus]
Doni, tiga belas gelas kopi
Hari ini lunas tanpa uang
Bayar kapan, Nak? Sudah, Bu, sudah
Fotonya dipaku di atas termos
[Outro - harmonica, last guitar chord]
Rahmat, giliranmu
Cepat lulus, ya
